plugins.name: Autopilot
plugins.description: Watches every inbox feed (Chat, Gmail, Jira: any plugin that offers one) and, when an item matches one of your rules, opens a Claude tab that investigates it with a playbook you wrote, or runs one of the item's own actions (mark read, done) with no Claude at all, optionally only when the Jira issue a mail is about has the status you name (a live lookup through the Jira plugin). Read-only by its prompt unless a rule lists the actions its session may take; off by default; rules, playbooks and your standing instructions (base.md) are files in folders of yours (global ones for every project, and per project), edited in its panel, by hand or with Claude. Needs cc-cockpit 0.11.0.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Google Calendar
plugins.description: Your Google Calendar beside your Claude tabs: the meeting now and next with a countdown and Join, invitations to answer, today, tomorrow and the next days, reminders before a meeting starts, an event opened as a clean page to discuss with Claude. It changes nothing in Google Calendar but your answers to invitations.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Google Chat
plugins.description: Your Google Chat in lanes (Mentions, Direct messages, Spaces, Alerts, Recent), sorted by Jev triage, a conversation opened as a clean page to discuss with Claude, Mark read / Mark unread. It changes nothing in Google Chat but your read state.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Gmail
plugins.description: Your Gmail in lanes (Unread, Alerts, Read), Grafana alerts grouped, sorted by Jev triage, a thread opened as a clean page to discuss with Claude (a mail reading layout with cc-cockpit 0.13.0+: remote pictures only when you ask, through an optional proxy, the sender's footer folded), Jira mail with its issue (with bronos.jira), mark read / unread. It only ever changes the read state: it never archives, labels, trashes or sends.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Inbox
plugins.description: One list of what needs you across Chat, Mail and Jira (any plugin that offers an inbox feed, version 2), placed in groups by your own rules (Jev questions included), with done, snooze, undo and search, and Calendar's agenda in a slot. It reads the other plugins through their services and has no account of its own. Needs cc-cockpit 0.10.0.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Jev triage
plugins.description: Priority and kind for the items of source plugins (mail, Jira, chat), judged by Jev with project rules and your corrections: the "triage" plugin service.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Jev
plugins.description: Jev, TypeSafe's cheap typed classifier, as the "jev" plugin service: other plugins ask choice, yes/no and score questions (one request, or a grid over many items). OpenRouter, TypeSafe direct or a custom endpoint; default model typesafe/jev-1.14; usage counted per calling plugin, with a monthly spending cap. Choices only, no free-form text generation.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Jira
plugins.description: Your Jira Cloud issues in lanes (Backlog, In progress, Mentioned, On hold, Done), unread marks, sorted by Jev triage, discussed with Claude. Read-only towards Jira. Provides the jira service (issue status, the issue view) to other plugins, such as bronos.gmail, and an inbox-feed of your issues for Inbox.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Omarchy Theme
plugins.description: Makes cc-cockpit match your Omarchy desktop. Pick the theme "Omarchy" in Settings › Appearance and it follows whichever Omarchy theme is active: switch Omarchy from Tokyo Night to Catppuccin, Rose Pine or a light theme, and the app, its panels and the Claude terminals re-colour within a second, with no restart. How it works: the plugin reads the palette Omarchy writes for the active theme (~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/colors.toml) and maps it onto the app's colours: background and bar shades, text, accent, borders, session status dots, tab flags. The terminal gets the same 16 colours as Omarchy's own terminal, so a Claude tab matches the terminal next to it. It only reads those files; it runs no commands and sends nothing anywhere. Without Omarchy (another desktop, or a Mac) it is a Tokyo Night theme. Needs cc-cockpit 0.15.0 or later.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Example
plugins.description: A click counter to copy as a starting point for your own plugin. One panel, one setting, one command.
